title.zh: 干法刻蚀vs 湿法刻蚀

subtitle.zh: 从原理到选型，8个问题讲清楚
subtitle.en: From principles to process selection: eight questions explained

body.zh: 机制区别；液相反应与气相/等离子体作用有何不同；等离子体；中性气体；离子；湿法；常见RIE
body.en: Mechanism differences How do liquid reactions differ from gas/plasma action? Plasma Neutral gas Ions Wet etch Typical RIE

body.zh: 方向控制；侧壁形状取决于反应与方向性控制；方向性；各向同性；晶面选择性
body.en: Directional control Sidewall shape depends on reaction and directional control Directional Isotropic Crystallographic selectivity

body.zh: 材料选择；去掉目标层，还要保住其他材料；掩膜；选择性去除；目标层；停止层；刻蚀前；刻蚀后
body.en: Material selectivity Remove the target while preserving other materials Mask Selective removal Target layer Stop layer Before etch After etch

body.zh: 工艺流程；刻蚀前后处理共同决定最终结果
body.en: Process flow Pre- and post-etch treatment jointly determine the result

body.zh: 参数窗口；速率、形貌、选择比需要一起调；速率；形貌；均匀性；选择比；工艺窗口
body.en: Parameter window Tune rate, profile and selectivity together Rate Profile Uniformity Selectivity Process window

body.zh: 缺陷风险；损伤、腐蚀、残留与粘连都要查；损伤；腐蚀；残留；粘连
body.en: Defect risks Check damage, corrosion, residue and stiction Damage Corrosion Residue Stiction

body.zh: 量测验证；尺寸、深度、残留与电性构成闭环；尺寸；深度；缺陷；电性；反馈优化
body.en: Metrology validation Dimensions, depth, residue and electrical properties close the loop Dimensions Depth Defects Electrical properties Feedback optimization

body.zh: 选型逻辑；从材料、形状和整合要求选择路线
body.en: Selection logic Choose the route from material, shape and integration requirements
